# confluent_notifications_integration Resource

[![General Availability](https://img.shields.io/badge/Lifecycle%20Stage-General%20Availability-%2345c6e8)](https://docs.confluent.io/cloud/current/api.html#section/Versioning/API-Lifecycle-Policy)

`confluent_notifications_integration` provides an Integration resource that enables creating, editing, and deleting Integrations on Confluent Cloud.

-> **Note:** It is recommended to set `lifecycle { prevent_destroy = true }` on production instances to prevent accidental integration deletion. This setting rejects plans that would destroy or recreate the integration, such as attempting to change uneditable attributes. Read more about it in the [Terraform docs](https://www.terraform.io/language/meta-arguments/lifecycle#prevent_destroy).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "confluent_notifications_integration" "example" {
  display_name = "Slack integration"
  description = "A Slack channel integration"
  slack_target {
    webhook_url = "https://hooks.slack.com/services/{id}/{id}/{id}"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:

- `display_name` - (Required String) A human readable name for the particular integration
- `description` - (Optional String) A human readable description for the particular integration
- `slack_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `webhook_url` - (Required String) Slack Webhook URL for the particular Slack channel
- `webhook_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `url` - (Required String) URL endpoint for the webhook
- `ms_teams_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `webhook_url` - (Required String) MS Teams Webhook URL for the particular team channel

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the preceding arguments, the following attributes are exported:

- `id` - (Required String) The ID of the Integration, for example, `int-abc123`.
- `api_version` - (Required String) API Version defines the schema version of this representation of a resource.
- `kind` - (Required String) Kind defines the object this REST resource represents.
- `resource_name` - (Required String) The Confluent Resource Name of the Integration.
- `role_email_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `role_name` - (String) name of the role
- `user_email_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `user` - (String) Reference to the user
- `in_app_target` - (Optional Configuration Block) Supports the following:
    - `user` - (String) Reference to the user the in-app target belongs to.

## Import

-> **Note:** `CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_KEY` and `CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET` environment variables must be set before importing an Integration.

You can import an Integration by using Integration ID, for example:

```shell
$ export CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_KEY="<cloud_api_key>"
$ export CONFLUENT_CLOUD_API_SECRET="<cloud_api_secret>"
$ terraform import confluent_notifications_integration.example int-abc123
```

!> **Warning:** Do not forget to delete terminal command history afterwards for security purposes.
